shorts.title: A Bull Bison Plows Snow With Its Face (Up to 900 kg)
shorts.outro: The full video is linked below.
shorts.description: A Yellowstone bison clears winter snow by swinging its head side to side, powered by a hump of muscle on a bull that can weigh about 900 kg, and what that swing did to Doug is in the full episode.

cliffhanger_original.outro: That same swing is what a bison uses on people, and Doug went and stood exactly where the snow used to be. Full video below.
cliffhanger_original.end_card: WHAT DID THAT SWING DO TO DOUG?

shorts.hook: A bull bison plows snow with its face.

shorts.title: This Sofa With a Beard Can Run at 55 km/h
shorts.description: A bison spends nine to eleven hours a day with its head down eating, then runs at up to about 55 km/h, and what Doug's stopwatch read is in the full episode.

cliffhanger_original.outro: So Doug timed one with a stopwatch, standing on the finish line for the best view. The reading is in the full video below.

shorts.title: A Bison Bull Can Lose Nearly 90 kg in One Rut
shorts.outro: Bears have killed more people in Yellowstone than bison. Full video below.
shorts.description: During the rut a Yellowstone bull can lose almost 90 kg guarding, bellowing and fighting, and what happened when Doug tried to referee two of them is in the full episode.

cliffhanger_original.outro: Two bulls that size squared up in the dust that August, and Doug stepped between them with a whistle to referee. It's linked below.
cliffhanger_original.end_card: WHAT HAPPENED WHEN DOUG BLEW THE WHISTLE?
